note: In place (no hips travel). speed: m/s of ground under a planted foot; dir: (x, z) of travel in the model's frame (+x left, +z forward); cycles: gait cycles (two steps each) in the clip; contact: each foot's stances as [start, end] shares of the whole clip (end < start wraps); leftStrike: when the left foot lands. Gun: the gun's butt (translation) and turn (rotation) in the Spine2 joint's frame, the gun's own frame being the glTF one (barrel along -z); rifle-hold-low / -high are the two holds, one frame each, with the pelvis square.
handling: Handling clips (swap-*, reload-*, shotgun-pump, *-aim-*) are upper-body actions over rifle-hold-low: their spine, neck, head and collarbones are played as a difference from that hold. Extra nodes under Spine2: GunIn (the gun coming off the back in a swap), PalmL / PalmR (palm middle and hand turn), ElbowL / ElbowR (elbow). A gun track is its butt less that gun's carry shift. events: seconds; track: per frame, hold [left, right] (0 nothing, 1 Gun, 2 GunIn), curl [left, right] 0..1, and the loose parts where a clip moves them.
